correctness.rationale: All quantifiers cover complex-valued functions on the five-point set F3² with declared normalization. Exact character orthogonality gives the factor 9/625 between fourth Fourier moment and Q. The sum-fiber polynomial is independently reconstructed symbolically. Balancing follows from strict increase in the antipodal product. The mixture derivative has no interior maximum, leaving a line branch ≤3 and a symmetric branch F(z), whose unique maximum occurs at (√33−1)/4. The triangle-equality system gives exactly the nine restricted additive characters times scalar. Checker replay verifies symbolic identities, sharp radical constant and all character classes. Finite tests are supplemental.

value.rationale: The split zero cone xy=0 over the first odd field F3 is the canonical reducible plane quadratic and the first delicate boundary of 2→4 finite-field curve estimates. Its exact norm is strictly beyond every one-axis value 3 and flat input 77/25, and the optimizer is uniquely enhanced at the crossing with rigid Fourier character phase. This closes a natural sharp endpoint benchmark with motivated geometric distinction; no generalized all-field result is claimed.
